readback.name: Poincare.BufferedChartTransitionExtensions.exists_gated_chart_extensions
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E3 be EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), the real three-dimensional Euclidean vector space. For arbitrary universe u, let M : Type u carry a topology, be Hausdorff and compact, and carry an E3 charted-space structure that is C-infinity for the identity model with corners over R. Let A be AtlasData M. This data includes a finite family of extended charts C_k = extChartAt at anchors a_k, open regions covering M whose closures lie in their chart sources and have compact coordinate images, and a smooth partition of unity p_k on all of M subordinate to those regions. The index set is Fin A.cover.chartCount. Let xi_k : E3 -> R be total functions. Assume for every k that xi_k has compact topological support S_k, that S_k is contained in the target of C_k, that the fixed GeodesicTransport cutoff c_k based at a_k equals one on some full Euclidean neighborhood of every point of S_k, and that c_k likewise equals one on some full Euclidean neighborhood of every point of Q_k = C_k image tsupport(p_k), the defined coordSupport A k. Topological support is the closure of the nonzero set. These premises do not require xi_k to be smooth, to lie in [0,1], or to equal one; the cutoff-one hypotheses concern the separately defined c_k. No connectedness, Riemannian metric, or time variable is explicitly assumed. For each ordered pair i,j, set T_ij(z) = C_j(C_i.symm(z)), the defined change A i j, which is the coordinate transition from i coordinates to j coordinates. Set K_ij = C_i image (tsupport(p_i) intersect (C_j.symm image S_j)). Set G_k to be the locus of z in E3 where c_k equals one on some full Euclidean neighborhood of z. Set O_ij = source(C_i.symm.trans C_j) intersect G_i intersect T_ij preimage G_j. The partial-homeomorphism source requires z to lie in target(C_i) and C_i.symm(z) to lie in source(C_j); trans applies C_i.symm first and C_j second. Each predicate function E3 -> Prop in the draft is used as the corresponding set; each preimage is an ordinary set preimage under the total function T_ij. Then there exist simultaneous families theta_ij : E3 -> R and F_ij : E3 -> E3 for all ordered chart pairs. For every i,j, theta_ij is globally C-infinity, has compact topological support, has all values in the closed interval [0,1], and has its topological support contained in O_ij. At every z in K_ij, theta_ij equals one on a full Euclidean neighborhood of z. F_ij is globally C-infinity and has compact topological support. At every z in the topological support of theta_ij, F_ij agrees with the actual total function T_ij on a full Euclidean neighborhood of z. Thus the equality is a germ condition, stronger than pointwise equality only on that closed support. For every pair there also exists L : NNReal such that F_ij is globally LipschitzWith L, equivalently dist(F_ij(x),F_ij(y)) <= L * dist(x,y) for all x,y in E3. L is quantified inside the pairwise conclusion and may depend on i,j; no supplied common bound is asserted. F_ij is not prescribed as theta_ij smul T_ij, and no support inclusion tsupport(F_ij) subset O_ij, global injectivity, inverse map, or global coordinate cocycle is asserted. The localization to O_ij is stated for theta_ij. Every germ uses ambient nhds. C-infinity denotes the ENat top injected into WithTop ENat.
